title: Project list
responsibility: Lists shared projects with repository, membership role and navigation actions.

inputs.name: ProjectList.projects
inputs.description: Required project summaries in display order, including identity, name, source repository and role.

outputs.name: ProjectList
outputs.description: Project cards with owner/repository and role, full-document Open links to Pages, and Members links only for owners. An empty list explains creating a shared project or receiving an invitation.
